data-grid.vueCode:
<script setup>
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import 'nnuikit/css';
import 'nnuikit/client';

const gridRef = ref(null);

onMounted(() => {
  if (!gridRef.value) return;
  const mockData = Array.from({ length: 15000 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: i + 1,
    ticker: `SYM-${(1000 + i % 500)}`,
    price: (Math.random() * 500).toFixed(2),
    status: i % 3 === 0 ? 'Executed' : 'Pending'
  }));
  gridRef.value.setData(mockData);
});
</script>

<template>
  <ui-data-grid
    ref="gridRef"
    persist="url"
    sync="cross-tab"
    row-height="40"
    overscan="6"
    style="height: 420px;"
  />
</template>
data-grid.svelteCode:
<script>
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import 'nnuikit/css';
  import 'nnuikit/client';

  let gridEl;

  onMount(() => {
    if (!gridEl) return;
    const mockData = Array.from({ length: 15000 }, (_, i) => ({
      id: i + 1,
      ticker: `SYM-${(1000 + i % 500)}`,
      price: (Math.random() * 500).toFixed(2),
      status: i % 3 === 0 ? 'Executed' : 'Pending'
    }));
    gridEl.setData(mockData);
  });
</script>

<ui-data-grid
  bind:this={gridEl}
  persist="url"
  sync="cross-tab"
  row-height="40"
  overscan="6"
  style="height: 420px;"
/>
